decisions: Sent, waiting, received and complete remain separate visible states.
External and manual payments require canonical recipient confirmation unless an exact trusted provider result supplies equivalent receipt.
Exact wallet receipt may close only the exact matching payment item.
Partial payment closes only the confirmed amount and preserves the remainder.
Retries and recovery reuse the existing payment identity.
Overall Position and group balances are recomputed derived views.
Saved payment records are human-readable and retrievable through an ordinary authenticated web path.
Reversal reopens only the exact affected payment item.
Shared return routes preserve the selected method and latest accepted result.
Payer refresh reads status and cannot open recipient confirmation controls.
Unknown timeouts require recovery; execution retry requires proof of non-execution.
